thread.title: Dow Jones Industrial Average Just Saw Its Sixth Worst Point Day in 121 Years

author: thestreet.com
title: Dow Jones Industrial Average Just Saw Its Sixth Worst Point Day in 121 Years
text:
After Friday's drubbing for stocks, it's time for a stiff drink.
The 666.75 point decline in the Dow Jones Industrial Average marked the sixth worst session dating back to 1896, according to S&P Global . Investors haven't seen a plunge of this magnitude since the throes of the Great Recession on Dec. 1, 2008 when the Dow tanked 679.95 points.
Fortunately for investors, the stunning reversal in stocks may be short-term.
Companies such as tech giant Apple ( AAPL ) are sitting on records amount of cash , dividend payouts are rising, stock buybacks continue and mergers and acquisitions remain hot. Profit margins are at record highs and borrowing costs remain low, even if they are poised to rise further amid actions from the Federal Reserve.
Above all else, there are no signs of an impending recession.
